summary: Confirmed all 25 estimates: five creative-writing gain contrasts, five creative-discussion-quality contrasts, and all 15 survival-ranking gain contrasts. Read the entire markdown conversion, including Appendices A-H, and checked every numerical source against extracted PDF text on pages 6, 16, 47, 48, 52 and 53. Values, signs, table columns, arm labels, analysis counts, confidence-interval targets and coding agree with the paper and codebook. Methods and rubrics support immediate after_ai for individual gains, with_ai for creative discussion, active human-partner comparisons, and uncertainty accounting for teams. No additional eligible full-sample outcome contrast was found. Separate rubric dimensions have no reported treatment contrasts; self-reports, detection measures, post-treatment BDI adjustment/moderation, mediation and AI-only language analyses are appropriately excluded. The extraction already documents the paper’s inconsistent BDI labels and uncertainty reporting; these do not introduce an extraction error.
